status: Predeclared before fitting any A3 candidate
test_use: No A2 test labels, URLs or features used for fitting, scoring, tuning or selection. Split group metadata may be checked for disjointness only.
demos: No demo URLs are injected. Existing naturally occurring domains remain. Candidate demo outputs are withheld until after metric-based selection.
scope: Original train/validation rows eligible for the unchanged A3 HTTP(S) validation policy; scheme-less dataset rows completed with https solely for training/paired evaluation, not relabelled.
policy: a3-scheme-neutral-v1: common HTTPS feature view, hostname lowercase/trailing-dot consistency, empty root path '/', remove default port for original protocol. Preserve www, userinfo, custom ports, path/query case, percent encoding, fragments and parameter order. Raw URL remains used for explanation and HTTP warnings.

integration_gate.notes: Chosen before candidate fitting. Recall trade-offs versus both native-A2 and API-formatted baselines must be reported, even if the gate passes. This is a research acceptance rule, not a product safety standard.

selection: Among candidates passing all gates, minimise deployment-like validation FPR; tie-break by higher dangerous recall, then smaller candidate complexity. No threshold search. No test-based selection.
metrics: TN FP FN TP, FPR=FP/benign, dangerous recall=TP/dangerous, subtype recalls; same deployment-like cohort for before/after. Also report native/raw A2 validation separately and deterministic domain-sampled format stability.
uncertainty: Validation is reused for model development; no unbiased final-test estimate or live safety/ownership claim. HTTP versus HTTPS is a transport stress test, not guaranteed same resource. Familiar domains are only diagnostic examples.
